calls.name: marketplace_items
calls.chain:
supabase
      .from('marketplace_items')
      .select('*')
      .gte('rating', 3.5) // Only well-rated items
      .order('downloads', { ascending: false })
      .limit(6)

        type: dto.type,

        author_id: user.id,
        data: dto.data,
        price: dto.price || 0,
        image_url: dto.image_url || null,
        tags: dto.tags || [],
        rating: 0,
        downloads: 0,
      })

      .single()
